estimands.completion_rate_difference_percentage_po: 100 * mean(union task_completed - planner task_completed) over seed-matched episodes
estimands.realized_hazard_cost_difference_steps: sum(union cost_hazards steps - planner cost_hazards steps) over a 128-episode paired resample

interpretation_rule: Call a paired difference statistically separated from zero only when its two-sided percentile interval excludes zero.
scope: Post-hoc uncertainty analysis of already committed seed-matched final episode summaries; no benchmark rerun, final-catalog reopening, model selection, threshold choice, or deployment change.
